name: blog-image
description: > Paid Gemini image generation for blog heroes, inline illustrations, and OG cards (direct API by default, optional MCP for edits). Asks for explicit consent before the first paid call. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog image, "generate a blog hero image", "blog illustration", "edit this blog image", "OG image", or when blog-write or blog-rewrite needs a hero. Not for charts (blog-chart) or stock-photo search.
author: AgriciDaniel
